items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ben Norrisingle, that's right. And you say you worked in his band then too or how was that? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No, he wasn't. He was just a singer. No, he wasn't in Troy's band.

ctx.x: Ben Norrisingle, that's right. And you say you worked in his band then too or how was that? In whose band? Ben Norrisingle.
Did he have a band? No, he was part of Troy Foer's band, wasn't he?
